name: reuse-generated-pr-rules
reason: Reuse the shared PR policy and format instead of keeping a divergent worker copy.
anchor:
- Open every PR ready for review, never as a draft.
- PR title: `type(scope): subject`.
- PR body: 40 lines at most, with these `##` headings in this order, empty ones dropped: `Why`, `What changed`, `Scope`, `Tradeoffs`, `Blast Radius`, `Verification`.
replace: - For authorized PRs, use the [Opening a PR](playbooks/opening-a-pr.md) playbook for readiness, title and format.
